captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a industrial welding positioner vise mounted on a turntable. It features a dark grey rectangular base plate, upon which a circular grey swiveling turntable base is mounted. Atop this turntable sits a mechanical vise assembly consisting of a stationary rear jaw block, a movable front jaw block that slides along prismatic dovetail guide ways, and a central cylindrical leadscrew driven by a black crossbar handle.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a welding positioner vise using CadQuery. The design must feature a flat rectangular base plate, a circular swiveling turntable base, a fixed rear jaw block, a sliding front jaw block guided on prismatic ways, and a central leadscrew driven by a crossbar handle.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly by defining a rectangular base plate using a Box primitive. A revolving turntable is created using Cylinder primitives. The main vise body, including the fixed rear jaw, is constructed by combining Box and Cylinder primitives. The sliding front jaw is modeled as a separate block, and the leadscrew assembly is built using cylindrical shafts and a crossbar handle with end caps. These components are linked together with appropriate joints to represent the rotational and linear degrees of freedom.
